verdict.rationale: n8n documents a command-line interface for configuration/administration tasks (e.g., user management, workflow import/export) at docs.n8n.io/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/use-the-command-line, confirmed by probe. However this is an operational/admin CLI, not an AI-native CLI designed for agentic workflows or programmatic AI-driven interaction. Missing for 10: evidence of an AI-native CLI use case (e.g., natural-language driven commands, agent-oriented CLI features), independent hands-on validation of CLI capabilities.
